about.title: About Pax Autocratica
about.description: Developed by Multiverse for Steam on Windows, Pax Autocratica is a single-player Colony Sim + FPS Roguelite. Colony decisions revolve around four core states: Fear, Happiness, Hunger, and Loyalty.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.question: What kind of game is Pax Autocratica?
faq.answer: It combines colony management with first-person roguelite expeditions. You manage people and production at the colony, then take direct control during runs.
